'''Ssiskor''' was a [[kulai]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] of the [[Kriek]]. According to legend, Ssiskor provoked the [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] [[Br'lai]], who rose up and destroyed an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] force that had tried to claim [[Kriekaal]] as their own.<ref name="Scout" />
